title: Dates
summary: The days somebody else fixed: a deadline, a window with a last day, and a date that comes round each week, month or year.
changes: The first version: a list of dates, a calendar of them, and a daily check that moves a repeating date on to its next turn.
author: BrainDog

declarations.name: Dates
declarations.holds: the days somebody else fixed: a deadline, an event, or a window from one day to a last day, and whether it comes round again
declarations.title: what
Move a repeating date on to its next turn once its last day has passed, every day

blocks.heading: On the calendar
blocks.empty: No date falls this month or the next two. Add a date with its day, and it is put on the calendar.

blocks.heading: Windows
blocks.empty: No window is open or coming. A date with a last day is a window, such as a fair that runs four days.

blocks.heading: What is coming
blocks.empty: Nothing is coming. A date goes here with what it is and the day somebody else fixed.
